properties.name: viewModelOrder
properties.description: Order value for sorting View Models. NOTE: This value is used in the former subdivided data panel. The updated panel uses a unified order value via the ParentableDataItem mixin.

properties.name: defaultInstanceId
properties.description: The default instance attached to the view model.

properties.name: editingInstanceId
properties.description: The selected inspector instance. Saves to local editor properties.

properties.name: viewModelType
properties.description: Identifies view models that have special uses, like text input view models

properties.name: shouldPublish
properties.description: An option to opt-out of publishing a component.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Non-unique identifier, used to give friendly names to any view model component.

properties.name: parentId
properties.description: Id of a parent folder within the data panel tree.

properties.name: groupId
properties.description: Id of the data source/type group. Typically either a group representing a library or an data type.

properties.name: displayOrder
properties.description: Order items should be displayed within the updated data panel.
